---
title: "Instacart — Interactive Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
    theme: cosmo
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(forcats)
set.seed(1)
```


```{r}
# Load the Instacart dataset 
instacart = p8105.datasets::instacart


n = nrow(instacart)

size = min(50000, n)

# Randomly sample rows for a lighter version of the dataset,
small = instacart |>
  slice_sample(n = size) |>  
  mutate(
    # Convert numeric day to ordered 
    order_dow = factor(
      order_dow,
      levels = 0:6,
      labels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat")
    ),
    # Recode the binary reordered flag
    reordered = factor(
      reordered,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("First time", "Reordered")
    )
  )
```
## Top 15 aisels Bar Plot
```{r}
top_aisles =
  small |>
  count(aisle, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  mutate(aisle = fct_reorder(aisle, n))

p_bar =
  ggplot(top_aisles, aes(x = aisle, y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Orders", title = "Top 15 Aisles")

ggplotly(p_bar)
```

## Line plot
```{r}
hourly =
  small |>
  count(order_dow, order_hour_of_day, name = "orders")

p_line =
  ggplot(hourly, aes(x = order_hour_of_day, y = orders, group = order_dow)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ order_dow, nrow = 2) +
  labs(x = "Hour of day", y = "Orders", title = "Hourly Order Volume by Weekday")

ggplotly(p_line)
```
## scatter plot
```{r}
scatter_sample =
  small |>
  slice_sample(n = min(10000, nrow(small))) |>
  mutate(hover = paste0(
    "Hour: ", order_hour_of_day,
    "<br>Cart pos: ", add_to_cart_order,
    "<br>Status: ", reordered
  ))

p_scatter =
  plot_ly(
    data = scatter_sample,
    x = ~order_hour_of_day,
    y = ~add_to_cart_order,
    color = ~reordered,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    text = ~hover,
    hoverinfo = "text",
    opacity = 0.5
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Hour of day"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Add-to-cart position"),
    title = "Cart Position vs Time of Day"
  )

p_scatter
```
## Box Plot
```{r}
dept_box =
  small |>
  filter(!is.na(days_since_prior_order)) |>
  mutate(
    department = fct_lump_n(department, n = 12),
    department = fct_reorder(department, days_since_prior_order, .fun = median, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

p_box =
  plot_ly(
    data = dept_box,
    x = ~department,
    y = ~days_since_prior_order,
    type = "box"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = ""),
    yaxis = list(title = "Days"),
    title = "Time Between Orders by Department (Top 12, lumped)"
  )

p_box
```
